subject: ACME Renewal & Expansion — Recap and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: ACME Renewal & Expansion — Recap and next steps

Hi Jordan (and Pat),

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the open conversation. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we're all aligned.

TL;DR: ACME will renew current hosted capacity and is evaluating a dedicated pool to support two new high-throughput workloads (semantic search + embeddings for personalized recommendations). Key blockers are cost predictability and intermittent latency spikes during peak batch jobs.

What we covered
- Current usage: ~1.2M tokens/day with 48% growth YoY; Q2 average latency is within SLO for most requests, but you hit 300–500ms tail on large batched rerank jobs (attached Q2 usage report).
- Pain points:
  - Latency spikes during nightly batch reranks impacting downstream refresh windows.
  - Cost variance driven by bursty peak traffic and CT-heavy tokens.
  - Need for auditability and longer retention for logs (security/compliance ask).
- New workloads discussed:
  - Semantic search service across product catalog (latency-sensitive, p99 target 150ms).
  - High-volume embeddings pipeline for personalization (throughput-focused).
- Proposed path
  - Short term: Renew hosted with committed usage for baseline predictable billing.
  - Mid term (Q3): Stand up Redwood Dedicated 2x GPU pool for the semantic search workload; migrate embeddings into a separate dedicated queue with autoscale.
  - Support: Add Premium Support (24/7) + expanded log retention for compliance audits.

Requested deliverables (owner / ETA)
1) Detailed cost estimate for Dedicated 2x GPUs + expected token/unit economics (Marissa) — sharing pricing workbook by EOD Fri, 6/26 (attached).
2) Technical deep dive to scope migration and P99 target validation (Dev) — propose Wed 7/1 or Thu 7/2.
3) Compliance evidence checklist & retention options (Vivek) — send SOC2/audit plan by 7/3.
4) DocuSign-ready MSA + PO timeline: target sign by 7/15 to hit Q3 rollout.

Attachments: ACME_Q2_usage_report.csv, draft_msa_v2.pdf, redwood_pricing_dedicated_2xGPU.xlsx

Next steps:
- I will upload the pricing workbook and a short SOW for the Dedicated migration by tomorrow.
- Please confirm the preferred slot for the technical deep dive and any additional stakeholders to loop in.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0138

Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference (hosted, dedicated, private)

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>

Cc: Pat Nguyen <pat.nguyen@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME Renewal & Expansion — Recap and next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Quick replies inline:

- Confirming the numbers on the usage report look correct on our side. The 300–500ms spikes are what cause our nightly job to slide past the DB maintenance window, which cascades into the morning batch reports.
- We like the Dedicated 2x GPU proposal; can you provide an estimated cutover effort and clearly called out rollback steps? We need a low-risk migration plan.
- For pricing, can you show a comparison: current hosted renewal vs hosted + committed baseline vs dedicated? Pat is particularly sensitive to the committed spend.

Proposed attendees for the technical deep dive: myself, Pat (eng manager), and two engineers from our infra team (I'll confirm names once I check calendars). Wed 7/1 10:00am PT works for us.

Also — one compliance note: our security team needs confirmation that log retention for inference traces can be set to 1 year and exported for audits.

If you can send the pricing workbook and SOW by tomorrow, we'll review and get back quickly.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Lee
Platform Engineering Lead | ACME Corp
jordan.lee@acme.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

- Pricing comparison: attached pricing workbook includes a three-column view (renewal-only / renewal+committed / dedicated 2xGPU). I'll highlight the committed baseline that gives you predictable unit pricing.
- Log retention: Vivek will share our retention options; we support 90 days by default and can configure up to 3 years for an additional retention fee — we'll document export formats for audits.
